title: The run-state contract lists the record layouts gvc added (absorptions, predictions, scores)
description: From gvc finding 1b09e63d (wz0). contracts/ticfac-run-state.json (vendored from ticks, pinned) lists the run branch's record layouts, and predates the records gvc added under .ticfac/runs/<run>/ (absorption decisions, predictions, scores, the depth bound). Add them in ticks' contract, cut a bundle version, and re-pin ticfac, so both readers agree on what a run branch may carry.
acceptance_criteria: The run-state contract names every record layout ticfac writes; ticks' bundle is re-cut and ticfac pinned to it; the contract readers pass in both repos
